result.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
result.summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PCBRouteAgent，一个受人类工程师「全局策略+局部执行」协作方式启发的多模态 PCB 布线智能体：全局布线规划器结合板图与结构化电气/几何信息给出连接拓扑、布线顺序、走线通道与层切换，细节执行器调用 KiCad 原生引擎并做有界局部恢复，失败以结构化反馈触发有针对性修订，在 PCBWorld-Bench 四个划分共 247 块板上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分层「先规划后执行」、失败反馈驱动的有界局部恢复与保留已接受结果，可能为 LVR 中的潜空间规划、视觉证据筛选及停止/回退决策提供类比线索，但任务领域相距较远，可供核查迁移价值有限。
